question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A plan or route to be followed on a journey
solution:
The correct answer is **'itinerary'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Itinerary** means a detailed plan for a route to be followed or places to be visited. 

 
 
• Example- Our **itinerary** included stops at several cathedrals.
